attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: The normal form is not proved for arbitrary EF reasoning that invokes SAT self-reducibility, extension variables encoding witnesses, or nonlocal formula transformations not decomposed into explicit EqSAT links.
steps: Fix Psys=EF+SATeq_N: EF plus explicitly checkable equisatisfiable formula identities such as padding, renaming, and clause duplication.
Test the previous parser theorem against the paired-padding generator G_N(x,2i)=Pad(G_N(x,2i-1)). EF+SATeq_N proves equality of paired SAT labels and hence XOR cancellation.

Observe that a private occurrence-label spoof that flips only one member of a pair is not a model of EF+SATeq_N. Therefore the old occurrence-relativizing falsifier is not valid against this proof system.

Repair the observable from ForcedRows_occ to a semantic-link transcript T_N containing occurrence values, constants, and EqSAT equality edges. A row is covered when its parity vector is determined modulo these links.

Derive the residual upper bound C(H_N^SAT)<=S_T+S_D+O(E_N N). Thus any accepted certificate with subthreshold transcript and fewer than N^{epsilon-o(1)} uncovered rows is a concrete falsifier for a claimed N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} source lower bound.

Attempt to extend the repair to all EF+SATeq_N proofs by translating each proof inference into the link transcript. The translation works for padding, renaming, duplicate clauses, and local formula isomorphisms.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This cycle proves a countermodel to pure occurrence extraction and a valid residual-audit lemma for link transcripts. It does not prove the full formula-semantic extraction theorem for EF+SATeq_N, and it makes no claim toward P != NP without an independent source lower bound for H_N^SAT.

assumptions: Circuit model is nonuniform Boolean circuits of fan-in two, with equality-to-a-row tests costing O(N) gates per patched source row.

EF+SATeq_N contains ordinary EF reasoning plus a sound schema for explicitly checkable equisatisfiable formula identities; this is SAT-semantic and nonrelativizing, not an occurrence-label oracle rule.
Functional extraction means the accepted proof defines a truth-table property over arbitrary label vectors with constructivity and density sufficient for the previously audited naturalization gate.
Occurrence extraction means the parsed transcript is invariant under private flips of SAT labels not syntactically touched by the proof; this invariance fails for EqSAT-linked labels.
All asymptotics are for valid lengths N in the generator family, with q,rho,epsilon fixed constants and d>1 in the polylogarithmic query window.
definitions: source object: H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)), with |x|=N, M_N=N^{q+o(1)}, generated formulas of length L_N=(log N)^d, and generator circuit size N^{rho+o(1)}.
target object: a proof-mediated source certificate in Psys=EF+SATeq_N for Ckt(H_N^SAT)>N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}, used only to support the beta-zero magnification route.

controlled interface: beta=0 substitution of a polynomial-size SAT circuit on L_N-bit formulas into the batched generator, plus a certificate parser that may expose occurrence rows or semantic EqSAT links.

target-preserving condition: max{rho,q}<1+epsilon, no nonuniform advice beyond the generated formulas and parsed proof transcript, and no upgrade from route-level source evidence to P != NP without the source lower bound.

EqSAT link: a proof-system edge asserting SAT(F)<->SAT(F') for formulas related by uniform padding, renaming, clause duplication, or another explicitly named equisatisfiable transformation admitted by EF+SATeq_N.

link-covered row: a source input x whose parity vector over the M_N generated SAT labels is determined over F_2 by occurrence values, constants, and EqSAT equality classes named by the parsed transcript.

equations.label: beta0_transfer
equations.valid_when: Valid when SAT on L_N-bit formulas has circuits of size L_N^c and the generator is substituted without advice leakage or positive target-query exponent.

equations.label: row_residual_patching
equations.valid_when: Applies when a circuit D_N of size S_D agrees with H_N^SAT outside E_N explicitly hardwired source rows and equality tests cost O(N).

equations.label: semantic_link_residual
equations.valid_when: Valid when the parsed EF+SATeq_N transcript T_N is label-free, has circuit cost S_T, and determines all but E_N rows through occurrence values or EqSAT links.

equations.label: source_threshold_consequence
equations.valid_when: Requires the row-residual patching bound and a claimed barely-superlinear source lower bound at the same valid generator lengths.

equations.label: pure_occurrence_failure_pattern
equations.valid_when: Applies to paired-padding carriers where EF+SATeq_N proves parity cancellation through semantic equality links rather than complete occurrence-row queries.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If arbitrary EF+SATeq_N proofs cannot be normalized into bounded label-free EqSAT-link transcripts, the repaired trichotomy remains an open problem rather than a theorem; if they can, subthreshold link coverage becomes a concrete falsifier for claimed source lower bounds.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Route-specific no-go plus repair lemma for the formula-semantic extraction fork; it blocks full occurrence parsing and names the stronger semantic-link residual audit needed before promotion.
candidate_lemmas.statement: For the beta-zero SAT parity carrier, pure occurrence-parser extraction is not valid for EF+SATeq_N. The repaired theorem must classify a short accepted certificate as functional-naturalizing, occurrence-full-row expensive, or EqSAT-link-covered; if the remaining uncovered rows are fewer than N^{epsilon-o(1)} and the link transcript is subthreshold, sparse-row patching gives a source-lower-bound falsifier.

assumptions: The lower-bound sentence is fixed syntactically, so the parser is not allowed to choose a different target predicate after seeing SAT labels.
Every admitted semantic equality rule has a finite certificate checkable in poly(L_N) or in the stated proof size measure.

The transcript is label-free: it may name formulas, transformations, and occurrence positions, but not hardwire the values SAT(F) except for syntactically trivial constants justified in the proof system.
The normal form is only claimed for EF+SATeq_N, not for arbitrary stronger systems with self-reduction, witness-search, or algebraic extension principles.
definitions: source object: an EF+SATeq_N proof pi of a lower-bound or hardness-certificate sentence LB(H_N^SAT,N^{1+epsilon}) for the beta-zero parity carrier.
target object: a bounded transcript T_pi that can be audited by ForcedRows, EqSAT-link coverage, and sparse-row residual patching.
controlled interface: parser pi -> T_pi with size blowup poly(|pi|,L_N) and no access to hidden SAT labels except through explicitly named proof rules.
target-preserving condition: the parser must preserve the beta-zero transfer parameters q,rho and cannot introduce advice depending on the full SAT truth table over the generated range.

equations.label: parser_size_goal
equations.valid_when: Valid only if each EF+SATeq_N inference is translated locally into occurrence, constant, or explicit EqSAT-link operations with bounded overhead.

equations.label: coverage_soundness_goal
equations.valid_when: Requires the transcript semantics to be sound over the real SAT interpretation and not merely over independently assignable occurrence labels.

equations.label: certificate_audit_threshold
equations.valid_when: Applies after the transcript computes or determines H_N^SAT off R(T_pi), so equality patching supplies an actual circuit upper bound.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: A single EF+SATeq_N proof rule that uses real SAT self-reducibility without reducible EqSAT links is a counterexample to this normal form and must be named as the semantic escape.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This is the exact open bridge lemma needed to turn the cycle-85 semantic-link trichotomy into a paper-ready theorem for a named strong proof system.
candidate_lemmas.statement: A sufficient completion of the top proof-delivery item is a semantic-link normal form: every short EF+SATeq_N lower-bound proof for H_N^SAT either yields a functional label property or converts to a label-free F_2 transcript of occurrence values, constants, and EqSAT edges whose uncovered-row set is sound for the actual SAT carrier.

assumptions: Padding preserves formula length within L_N^{O(1)} and is uniformly checkable inside EF+SATeq_N.
Rows contain paired occurrences in the same parity sum, so every paired label appears twice over F_2.
The occurrence parser is required to be invariant under independent label flips, and therefore cannot see semantic equality unless the parser is explicitly extended to EqSAT links.
definitions: source object: a beta-zero generator G_N with even M_N and pairs G_N(x,2i)=Pad(G_N(x,2i-1)) for a uniform satisfiability-preserving padding map.
target object: the occurrence-parser claim that any short nonfunctional certificate must expose N^{epsilon-o(1)} complete XOR rows.
controlled interface: EF+SATeq_N may prove SAT(F)<->SAT(Pad(F)) using the padding identity, while occurrence labels remain privately flippable only if EqSAT constraints are ignored.
target-preserving condition: this construction is a countermodel to the parser theorem only, not a hard source object, because the resulting carrier has an easy cancellation circuit.

equations.label: paired_identity
equations.valid_when: Valid when Pad is an explicitly admitted EF+SATeq_N equisatisfiable transformation and both paired formulas occur in the generated row.

equations.label: xor_cancellation
equations.valid_when: Applies over F_2 after every paired occurrence has the same real SAT label by the padding identity.

equations.label: parser_counterexample
equations.valid_when: Valid for the paired-padding countermodel where the short proof uses only EqSAT cancellations and the carrier is computed by the generator plus constant parity output.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If the proof system excludes padding-equivalence facts, this countermodel disappears; then the older occurrence-local full-row theorem may again be valid for that restricted system.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: Minimal countermodel separating occurrence-relativizing extraction from real SAT-semantic EF+SATeq_N reasoning.
candidate_lemmas.statement: There is a simple paired-padding generator showing that occurrence-only parsing is false already for EF+SATeq_N: each generated formula has an EqSAT-equivalent twin, EF+SATeq_N proves the labels equal, and the XOR carrier cancels without forcing complete occurrence rows.

control_decision.pivot_test: Pivot or demote if EF+SATeq_N has an explicit inference using SAT self-reducibility or witness reasoning that cannot be represented as a bounded label-free EqSAT-link transcript.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote only after proving the semantic-link normal form or producing a minimal named semantic-escape counterexample, plus the prior-art and inference-quality audits.
control_decision.reason: The branch made route-level progress by refuting pure occurrence parsing for a named proof system and replacing it with a sharper link-residual audit, but the full extraction theorem is blocked at a named normal-form lemma.

dependency_updates.description: The beta-zero transfer C(H_N^SAT)<=N^{max{rho,q}+o(1)} remains valid under q,rho<1+epsilon and no advice leakage.
EF+SATeq_N padding identities give a countermodel to occurrence-only parser extraction; private occurrence flips violate the EqSAT axioms.
Replace occurrence-only ForcedRows by a label-free F_2 transcript of occurrence values, constants, and EqSAT links, with sparse-row patching on uncovered rows.
Need to prove or refute that arbitrary EF+SATeq_N proofs normalize to bounded semantic-link transcripts; local padding rules are handled, but self-reduction-like reasoning is not.
Current packet is a no-go plus repaired audit theorem, not a main lower-bound claim; it is ready for proof-complexity transfer review focused on the normal-form gap.

falsifiers: Semantic-link falsifier: a subthreshold EqSAT-link transcript covering all but fewer than N^{epsilon-o(1)} rows gives an actual circuit upper bound by sparse-row patching.
Paired-padding falsifier: EF+SATeq_N can prove XOR cancellations with zero occurrence-forced rows, so a pure occurrence parser is not valid for this named proof system.

Functional-naturalization falsifier: if accepted certificates define dense constructive label properties over arbitrary truth tables, the route falls back into the naturalization audit rather than a SAT-semantic escape.
Positive-beta falsifier remains quarantined: any repair that reintroduces L_N=N^beta target queries obeys the old q+beta c transfer cap and loses all-exponent target preservation.
Advice-leakage falsifier: a transcript that hardwires SAT labels on the generated range is not valid source evidence, because it hides the target truth table in the certificate.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: As gamma_N approaches 1, occurrence ForcedRows remains small while EqSAT link coverage determines most row parities. If E_N<N^{epsilon-o(1)}, the carrier becomes subthreshold easy despite the occurrence parser reporting no full rows.
held_fixed_controls: L_N=(log N)^d with d>1, q,rho<1+epsilon, and generator size N^{rho+o(1)}.
Proof system fixed as EF+SATeq_N with only explicitly checkable padding, renaming, and duplicate-clause EqSAT rules.
No SAT truth-table advice is allowed in the transcript; only formula descriptions and link certificates are allowed.
The target bridge remains beta=0, so SAT in SIZE(n^c) still transfers as N^{max{rho,q}+o(1)} for every fixed c.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The proof fork is blocked by a concrete semantic distinction: occurrence labels can be privately spoofed, but EqSAT-linked formula pairs cannot. Varying the amount of semantic linking tests whether the repaired audit has a real threshold rather than another restatement of hardness magnification.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: A beta-zero XOR carrier with M_N=N^{q+o(1)} polylog-length SAT instances, where a gamma_N fraction of slots in every row are paired with uniformly padded EqSAT twins and the remaining slots are generated independently.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A uniform label-free link-transcript construction and an F_2 row-coverage calculation showing that uncovered rows are exactly the residual rows patchable at O(E_N N) cost before the intuition can affect proof obligations.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: gamma_N, the fraction of row parity positions covered by EF+SATeq_N padding-equivalence links; equivalently vary the residual uncovered-row exponent theta where E_N=N^theta.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 86 resolves one part of the formula-semantic fork: occurrence-only extraction is false for EF+SATeq_N because real EqSAT identities are nonrelativizing semantic links. The valid replacement object is a semantic-link residual transcript; subthreshold link coverage is a falsifier for source lower-bound certificates, while the open proof task is a normal form for arbitrary EF+SATeq_N reasoning.

negative_tactic_decision.conflict_target: Claimed source lower-bound certification for H_N^SAT at N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} when the proof only supplies subthreshold semantic coverage and fewer than N^{epsilon-o(1)} uncovered rows.
negative_tactic_decision.contradiction_carrier_or_no_go_family: Paired-padding EqSAT XOR carriers and, more generally, semantic-link residual transcripts with C(H_N^SAT)<=S_T+S_D+O(E_N N).
escape_conditions: A direct nonrelativizing lower bound for H_N^SAT that bypasses proof-mediated certificates.
A nonlarge or nonconstructive certificate that avoids functional naturalization and does not yield a label-free link transcript.
A named SAT-semantic proof principle, beyond EqSAT padding identities, that provably cannot be compressed into occurrence or EqSAT-link coverage.
A source lower bound stronger than the row-patching window S_T+S_D+O(E_N N).
negative_tactic_decision.exact_negation_or_method_class: Negate the claim that every short EF+SATeq_N proof either naturalizes or forces occurrence-complete rows; allow semantic EqSAT links and test whether they yield subthreshold residual circuits.
negative_tactic_decision.next_validation_handoff: Send to pvsnp-proof-complexity-transfer-reviewer and pvsnp-symbolic-complexity-auditor to verify the EF+SATeq_N definition, link-transcript cost, and row-patching exponent.
negative_tactic_decision.paper_contribution_potential: Potential paper-level refinement: a named no-go for occurrence-only parser theorems plus a sharper open problem/conditional theorem for semantic-link normal forms in EF+SATeq_N.
proof_obligations: Formalize EF+SATeq_N syntax, lower-bound sentence LB(H_N^SAT,N^{1+epsilon}), and the admitted EqSAT identity rules.
Prove the paired-padding countermodel to pure occurrence parsing with explicit proof size and generator parameters.
Prove the semantic-link residual upper bound and the threshold E_N>=N^{epsilon-o(1)} under a claimed source lower bound.
Attempt the parser normal form pi -> T_pi for all EF+SATeq_N inferences, or exhibit the first inference rule that defeats it.
Record naturalness, relativization, algebrization, and advice status for the semantic-link transcript interface.
negative_tactic_decision.reason_for_tactic: The positive-beta transfer cap is already avoided by beta=0; the decisive local risk is now that proof-mediated source certificates are explained by subthreshold occurrence or EqSAT-link transcripts.

branch_outputs.next_experiment: Work the EF+SATeq_N normal-form proof rule by rule: padding, renaming, duplicate clauses, extension-variable abbreviations, and SAT self-reduction; either translate each into a bounded EqSAT-link transcript or isolate the first noncompressible SAT-semantic principle as the next theorem-shaped counterexample.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: SemanticCompletion is not proved for full EF+SAT_U^comp. Local row assignments may violate global SAT self-reducibility or formula-composition constraints on non-generated formulas, and constructing a compatible completion appears to require a RowSyntaxRealizer or an explicit nonrelativizing SAT-semantic principle.
steps: Fixed the concrete proof system Psys=EF+SAT_U^comp rather than an unnamed strong system; its SAT facts are syntactic equality plus local composition axioms for S(F).
Formalized the lower-bound sentence LB_{N,s}: every circuit C of size <s_N differs from x -> xor_{j<=M_N} S(G_N(x,j)) on some x in {0,1}^{log N}.
Defined row supports recursively: generated atom S(G_N(x,j)) supports row x; equality preserves support; composition axioms support the union of their subformula supports.
Showed that propositional EF inference is syntactically invariant under changing unmentioned SAT atoms; the only possible leakage is through nonlogical SAT_U^comp axioms.

Derived the conditional sparse-patching contradiction: if SemanticCompletion supplies an easy residual D_N off K_pi and |K_pi|<N^{epsilon-o(1)}, then C(H_N^SAT)<=N^{lambda+o(1)}+O(|K_pi|N)<s_N, contradicting sound proof acceptance in the spoof model.
Tested the previous equality-only invariant against S(F or G)<->S(F) or S(G) and found a finite falsifier: equality fibers miss rows that subformula composition semantically touches.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: The packet proves a conditional row-forcing bridge and a finite no-go for equality-only lifting, but it does not classify arbitrary EF+SAT_U proofs and gives no evidence for P != NP.

assumptions: Model: Psys is EF+SAT_U^comp with propositional EF rules, syntactic formula equality, and sound local composition axioms such as S(F or G)<->S(F) or S(G), all length bounded by L_N^{O(1)}.
Uniformity: G_N is computable by circuits of size N^{rho+o(1)}, M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, and each generated formula has length L_N=(log N)^d.
Threshold regime: s_N=N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} and the off-support residual D_N has circuit size S(D_N)=N^{lambda+o(1)} with lambda<1+epsilon.
Parser assumption: each nonlogical SAT axiom instance in pi has a row-support set supp_row(a), and K_pi is the union over all such supports after equality and composition closure.
Semantic-completion assumption: for every D_N agreeing with H_N^SAT outside K_pi, the parsed proof has a model in which rows outside K_pi realize D_N while all axiom instances used by pi remain true.
Non-claim: this is a route-level conditional theorem; it is not a proof of P != NP and not yet a full EF+SAT_U extraction theorem.
definitions: source object: a concrete EF+SAT_U^comp proof pi of LB_{N,s}, where LB asserts that every circuit of size less than s_N fails to compute H_N^SAT(x)=xor_{j<=M_N} SAT(G_N(x,j)).
target object: a fork-resolving extraction/no-go statement for beta-zero SAT parity carriers, measured by semantic row charge |K_pi| and residual circuit size.

controlled interface: SemanticSupportParser(pi) returns rows K_pi touched by equality and SAT-composition axiom supports, and SemanticCompletion(K_pi,D_N) supplies a target-preserving spoof model for rows outside K_pi.

target-preserving condition: the spoof completion must preserve proof acceptance, all parsed SAT_U^comp axioms, the same input length N, the same lower-bound threshold s_N, and the same circuit target SIZE_N(s_N).

equations.label: beta_zero_carrier
equations.valid_when: Valid when the beta-zero carrier fixes N input rows, M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, and G_N outputs formulas of length L_N.

equations.label: semantic_support_union
equations.valid_when: Valid when every SAT-semantic axiom instance in the proof has been expanded through equality and composition supports.

equations.label: sparse_residual_patch
equations.valid_when: Valid when D_N agrees with H_N^{SAT} outside the parsed row set K_pi and exceptions are hardwired by row-index patches.

equations.label: forced_semantic_charge
equations.valid_when: Applies after Psys soundness, semantic completion, and the sparse-patch upper bound all preserve the same N and threshold s_N=N^{1+epsilon-o(1)}.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: Find an accepted EF+SAT_U^comp proof whose SAT-composition axioms have |K_pi|<N^{epsilon-o(1)} but for which no off-support semantic completion exists; the responsible axiom is then the precise nonrelativizing SAT-semantic escape.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This upgrades the full-system gap into one named bridge lemma: prove SemanticSupportParser plus SemanticCompletion for EF+SAT_U^comp, or obtain a sparse-support falsifier to the proof route.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Conditional row-forcing theorem for a concrete strong system: fix Psys=EF+SAT_U^comp, Extended Frege over circuit reasoning plus explicit SAT composition axioms for formulas of length at most L_N^{O(1)}. If a polynomial-time SemanticSupportParser maps every accepted proof pi of LB_{N,s}(H_N^SAT) to a row set K_pi and satisfies proof-invariance plus semantic-completion for off-support residuals, then any valid proof of C(H_N^SAT)>s_N=N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} forces |K_pi|>=N^{epsilon-o(1)} whenever the residual circuit exponent lambda is below 1+epsilon.

assumptions: F and G are syntactically distinct generated query formulas but both appear as subformulas of a composed formula B=F or G used in pi.
The proof system is allowed to instantiate the SAT axiom S(B)<->S(F) or S(G).
The equality-only parser does not recursively decompose B into generated subformula row supports.
definitions: source object: a finite EF+SAT_U^comp derivation using one composition axiom over generated formulas F=G_N(x_1,j_1) and G=G_N(x_2,j_2).
target object: the equality-only parser P_eq from the previous cycle, which charges only formula-DAG equality fibers.
bridge/carrier: the SAT-composition hyperedge with row support {x_1,x_2}.
observable: whether proof acceptance is invariant under changing SAT labels on rows not in the equality-closed set.

equations.label: or_support
equations.valid_when: Valid when composition axioms are parsed by syntactic subformula expansion down to generated SAT-query leaves.

equations.label: equality_parser_failure
equations.valid_when: Applies when B is not itself a generated query label and the parser charges only equality fibers rather than subformula supports.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: If every formula used in the proof is already a generated query label and no composition axiom is used, this obstruction disappears and the equality-closed theorem may remain valid.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This is a finite falsifier to any automatic lift from P_eq to full formula-semantic systems; the repair is semantic support, not ordinary soundness.
candidate_lemmas.statement: Equality-closed row charge is invalid for EF+SAT_U^comp. The axiom S(F or G)<->S(F) or S(G) semantically connects generated formulas even when F, G, and F or G lie in distinct equality fibers, so a parser that charges only shared-DAG equality can miss rows actually used by the proof.

assumptions: Projection width w_N=O(log N) or another explicit density certificate is available.
The proof verifier and projection map run in poly(N) time after pi is fixed or existentially searched over poly(N) many candidates.
Usefulness is universal over all circuits in SIZE_N(s_N), not merely over generated SAT-parity tables.
The target class admits PRFs secure against poly(N)-time distinguishers at the relevant size scale, if one invokes natural-proofs pressure.
definitions: source object: accepted proof pairs (pi,T) for lower-bound statements about the beta-zero SAT parity truth table.
target object: a constructive truth-table property P_N on N-bit functions useful against SIZE_N(s_N).
bridge/carrier: projection of proof acceptance to a bounded-width functional predicate on T.
observable: density of accepting truth tables and constructivity time.

equations.label: density_from_width
equations.valid_when: Valid when proof acceptance contains an accepting cylinder or projection cell of width w_N over truth-table coordinates.

equations.label: usefulness
equations.valid_when: Requires the extracted property to preserve the exact lower-bound target class and not merely a restricted certificate model.

candidate_lemmas.failure_test: The naturalization gate fails if projection width is superlogarithmic, constructivity is semantic/non-polynomial, or usefulness does not quantify over all SIZE_N(s_N) circuits.
candidate_lemmas.proof_role: This closes the functional branch by quarantine unless non-largeness, nonconstructivity, or nonuniform leakage is explicitly proved.
candidate_lemmas.statement: If short accepted proofs in the chosen system induce a functional truth-table property P_N(T) that is decidable in poly(N), accepts H_N^SAT, rejects every truth table computed by SIZE_N(s_N), and has logarithmic projection width, then the functional branch is a valid natural property and faces the standard PRF conflict for the same target class.

control_decision.pivot_test: Backtrack if no concrete SAT_U axiom family can be parsed into row supports or if SemanticCompletion is equivalent to proving the intended lower bound.
control_decision.promotion_test: Promote if the OR-block experiment yields either a checked SemanticCompletion theorem with the forced-row lower bound, or a minimal EF+SAT_U countermodel naming the nonrelativizing semantic axiom.
control_decision.reason: The top proof-delivery item is not solved, but the obstruction is now a named lemma rather than generic strong-system difficulty: prove SemanticCompletion for EF+SAT_U^comp or identify the exact SAT-semantic principle that invalidates spoof completions.

dependency_updates.description: Parser for EF+SAT_U^comp must charge subformula/composition row supports, not only equality fibers.
Need a model-completion theorem showing off-support residual truth tables can satisfy all SAT_U^comp axiom instances used by pi.
S(F or G)<->S(F) or S(G) is a finite obstruction to lifting P_eq row charge to stronger formula-semantic systems.
If extraction is functional with logarithmic projection width, it naturalizes as a large constructive useful property for the same SIZE target.

falsifiers: Finite composition falsifier: B=F or G with F=G_N(x_1,j_1), G=G_N(x_2,j_2) defeats an equality-only parser because B is not in either generated equality fiber but its SAT axiom depends on both rows.

Sparse semantic-support falsifier: if an accepted proof has |K_pi|<N^{epsilon-o(1)} and a valid semantic completion to an easy D_N exists, then sparse patching gives C(H_N^SAT)<N^{1+epsilon-o(1)} and refutes the claimed source lower-bound certificate.

Natural-property falsifier: if the proof route becomes a poly(N)-constructive N^{-O(1)}-dense property useful against SIZE_N(s_N), then PRF tension applies to the exact target class unless the object is non-large or nonconstructive.

Formula-normalization falsifier: if a proof uses semantic equivalence of formulas without exposing generated leaves, then row-support extraction is not a syntactic parser and must be charged as a SAT-semantic escape rather than a valid occurrence-relativizing transcript.

gedanken_experiment_design.expected_observation: Equality charge stays near zero for B_Blk, while semantic-support charge grows like N^gamma per block. If total semantic charge is below N^epsilon, an easy residual completion would falsify the certificate; if it exceeds N^epsilon, the proof pays the same full-row threshold as the occurrence theorem.
held_fixed_controls: H_N^SAT, M_N<=N^{q+o(1)}, and G_N size N^{rho+o(1)} remain fixed.
The parser must be uniform and must not use advice about actual SAT values.
Residual patching cost remains O(|K|N) on complete rows.
gedanken_experiment_design.rationale: The abstract gap is now specifically SemanticCompletion for EF+SAT_U^comp; a concrete OR-block carrier tests whether semantic support, not equality support, is the right quantitative invariant.
gedanken_experiment_design.situation_seed: Take the beta-zero carrier with polylogarithmic 3CNF queries G_N(x,j), add proof atoms B_Blk=OR_{x in Blk} G_N(x,1) for blocks Blk of rows, and allow EF+SAT_U^comp to use S(B_Blk)<->OR_{x in Blk} S(G_N(x,1)) when the composed formula length stays within L_N^{O(1)}.
gedanken_experiment_design.transfer_certificate_needed: A formal SemanticCompletion theorem for these OR-block axioms, or a proof that OR-block SAT composition is already a nonrelativizing SAT-semantic principle outside the occurrence/full-row obstruction.
gedanken_experiment_design.varied_variable: block row exponent gamma where |Blk|=N^gamma, truncated to the maximum allowed by the formula-length bound.

branch_outputs.mathematical_learning: Cycle 86 sharpens the full formula-semantic fork: equality-closed charge is valid only for P_eq, while EF+SAT_U^comp needs semantic row support plus a separate SemanticCompletion theorem. The new finite falsifier is the SAT-composition axiom, and the new positive bridge is the conditional forced-charge inequality |K_pi|>=N^{epsilon-o(1)} under completion. This is route-level proof-boundary progress, not P != NP progress.

attempted_derivation.blocking_gap: Full EF+SAT_U with unparsed semantic formula identity may use actual SAT extensionality as a nonrelativizing proof principle; the current parser has no valid cover parameter for that rule.
steps: Fix P_wExt and parse pi into occurrence SAT queries Q_pi, definitional equality edges, witnessed extensionality edges W_pi, residual rows R_N, and forced rows F_N.
Contract definitional identity and extension-variable congruence edges into an equality quotient; charge the quotient opener by alpha_eq.
For each witnessed Ext(F,F',w), replace the opaque semantic equality by the supplied satisfiability-preserving transducer or quotient witness; charge its opener by alpha_wit.
Flatten occurrence openings, equality quotient openings, and extensionality witnesses into one adaptive cover with exponent alpha_ext=max{alpha_ad,alpha_eq,alpha_wit}.
For every nonexception row, compute the parity over M_N=N^{q+o(1)} generated SAT instances using the cover opener; this costs N^{q+alpha_ext+o(1)} plus generator overhead N^{rho+o(1)}.
Hardwire the truth values on residual and forced rows; the patch uses O((|R_N|+|F_N|)N) gates, giving exponent max{f,r}+1.
Taking the maximum of generator, low-cover evaluation, and patch costs yields C(H_N^SAT)<=N^{max{rho,q+alpha_ext,max(f,r)+1}+o(1)}.
Attempting the same derivation for full P_sem stops at a bare EqSAT(F,F') line, because no quotient, transducer, or occurrence transcript exists from which to recover row labels.
attempted_derivation.why_not_yet_a_proof: This is a theorem-shaped restricted-system falsifier, not a proof of P != NP or a full EF classification. It still needs a prior-art boundary check and a formal definition of which extensionality witnesses the chosen proof formalism admits.

assumptions: Model: circuits are unrestricted nonuniform Boolean circuits on the N-bit x input; proof parsing is uniform and does not use hard-row advice.

Proof system: P_wExt contains EF+SAT_U^{occ}, definitional equality, and Ext(F,F',w) only when w supplies a checkable E-uniform satisfiability-preserving transducer or quotient witness; no bare semantic identity axiom is allowed.
Parameter regime: M_N=N^{q+o(1)}, generator circuit size is N^{rho+o(1)}, equality quotient cover is alpha_eq, adaptive proof-opening cover is alpha_ad, and extensionality witness cover is alpha_wit.
Binding regime: after parsing pi, the induced approximator agrees with row parity outside residual rows R_N of size N^{r+o(1)} and forced/exception rows F_N of size N^{f+o(1)}.

Naturalness/barrier regime: the argument is a finite falsifier and does not construct a large useful property; it is valid only for low-cover witnessed proofs and is silent about opaque semantic SAT principles.
definitions: source object: a short EF+SAT_U^{wit-ext} proof pi of an alleged lower-bound or row-parity certificate for H_N^SAT, where each formula-identity or SAT-extensionality line carries an explicit quotient/transducer witness.
target object: an unrestricted Boolean circuit upper bound for H_N^SAT, used only as a route-specific falsifier of a stronger beta-zero lower-bound claim, not as evidence for P != NP.
controlled interface: parser pi -> (Q_pi,E_pi,W_pi,R_pi,F_pi) producing occurrence queries, equality quotient edges, witnessed extensionality openers, residual rows, and forced rows.

target-preserving condition: the parser, quotient contraction, witness openers, residual list, and patch circuit are E-uniform and advice-free, with SAT instance length L_N=(log N)^d and generator size N^{rho+o(1)}.
